name: Referenced bundled script or executable
description: A script/executable under .claude/skills/** or .claude/commands/** whose path is referenced by its owning SKILL.md or command file. Mutually exclusive with claude.payload.bundled-script below: both match on referenced with the same ^true$ regex, one matches and one notMatches.
message: A bundled script referenced by its skill or command is pre-wired to run on invocation

name: Bundled script or executable
description: A script/executable under .claude/skills/** or .claude/commands/** with no reference from its owning SKILL.md or command file. See claude.payload.referenced-script above: the two rules split the same entity population on referenced and never both fire.
message: An executable payload is bundled under .claude/skills or .claude/commands
